title: fix(app-shell): create the AI chat conversation on the first send, not on every visit
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBSiTKJwBzVjsLLbHidtAJNN)_

Fixes #32031

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：AI 聊天页、聊天侧栏（ChatDock）和 Studio Copilot 打开时不再新建会话，用户发出第一条消息时才创建。
- 为什么改：每次打开没有缓存会话的 AI 页都会多出一条空的 "New conversation"，会话列表被空行塞满。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端 app-shell，不动服务端；首条消息改为在会话建好后的下一个任务里补发。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`useChatConversation.ts` 的 `ensureConversation`，以及 `AiChatPage.tsx` 里 `useDeferredFirstSend` 的补发。
- 两分钟验证：打开 `/_console/ai` 三次不发消息，会话列表仍是 "No chats yet"；发一条后列表只有这一条，刷新后仍在这条会话里。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

**Option A (create on first send), not B.** The hook no longer calls `POST /conversations` while it resolves. When there is nothing to resume it settles with no conversation, and the first send creates one through a new `ensureConversation()`. Option B (reuse an empty row) was rejected from the code: the console creates rows with `{}`, so a row carries no scope and the client cannot tell which surface an empty row belongs to, and B would still mint one row on the first visit after every sign-in.

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useChatConversation.ts`
- The resolve no longer creates. With no cached or active id it settles "pending" for its cache key; a 404 on the cached id settles the same way.
- `ensureConversation()` returns the held id, or shares the one create in flight for the key, or creates and adopts it. A send that arrives while the resolve is still running is recorded and created when the resolve settles with nothing to resume (or joins the thread it found).
- `startNew()` and `?new` (`forceNew`) only drop the cache pointer and settle pending, so they mint nothing while the current thread is still empty. `reset()` deletes the current row and settles pending.
- `purgeChatCaches` is unchanged.

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` (`useDeferredFirstSend`)
- A send with no id stashes the message and calls `ensureConversation`; a stash seeded out of band (the Builder handoff) asks for it from the replay effect.
- A second submit while the create is on the wire does not replace the first message: the first one is replayed, and the shared create makes no second row.
- The replay now runs on the next task (`setTimeout(0)`, cleared with the effect). `useChat` stops its in-flight request in an effect cleanup, and StrictMode runs that cleanup right after the first effect pass on mount, so a replay issued inside the effect was aborted before it reached the wire. That was a narrow race before; with the row created by the first send it lost every first message in a dev build (seen in the browser check before this fix).

`ChatDockConversation.tsx`, `StudioAiCopilot.tsx`: pass `ensureConversation` to `ChatPane`. All three callers keep the pane keyed on the id, so the pane remounts when the id lands and replays the stashed first message there.

## Tests

- `hooks/__tests__/useChatConversation.test.tsx`: new describe "the conversation is created on the first send (objectstack#32031)" with 9 pins: N visits mint no row; a visit after a purge mints no row; a double ensure makes one POST; a reload after the first send resumes; a send during the resolve is created when it settles; a send during the resolve joins the found thread; `?new`/startNew mint nothing while empty; CONTROL, startNew from a used thread gets a fresh row on its first send; a failed create retries. Existing tests updated to the new semantics (no create on resolve).
- `console/ai/__tests__/useDeferredFirstSend.test.tsx`: the real hook and pane over a mocked fetch (mount creates nothing, the first send creates one row and is replayed; a fast double submit makes one row and keeps the first message; a handoff stash asks for the conversation), and a StrictMode pin (a pane whose effect cleanup aborts an in-flight send keeps the replayed first message).
- `AiChatPage.handoffNeverFromUrl-12493.test.tsx`: CONTROL, with no thread yet the first message creates one conversation and sends into it. Its `useObjectChat` mock now arms the parent id the way the real hook does (`parentConvRef`), since the send is deferred past the URL-mirror that drops the prop.
- `ChatDock.appBinding-10926.test.tsx`: the dock mints nothing on mount; the pins send a first message before they read the conversation.

Ablations (all through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to HEAD with an empty diff):
1. Restore the mount-time create in the hook's resolve: 4 pins red (N visits, after purge, `?new`/startNew, failed-create retry).
2. Remove the `ensureConversation` call from the replay effect: the handoff-ask pin and the page's handoff reload test red.
3. Replay synchronously inside the effect again: the StrictMode pin red (1 of 12 in the file).

## Acceptance notes

- Opening `/_console/ai` N times, including across sign-out and sign-in, with no message sent leaves no empty row: the hook pins (N visits, after purge) and the browser check below.
- `?new` and "New conversation" do not mint a second empty row while the current one is empty: the `?new`/startNew pin.
- The three callers: no row on mount, no lost first message, no double create on a fast double submit, and a reload after the first send resumes. The hook and deferred-send pins cover the shared path; the dock and page tests cover their callers.
- No server change.
- Ruling grep (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`) over the touched files. `useChatConversation.ts`, `StudioAiCopilot.tsx` and the deferred-send and hook tests: 0 hits. The hits are pre-existing and unrelated to this change:
  - `AiChatPage.tsx:2358` "the maintainer's AiBuild ruling retires"
  - `AiChatPage.tsx:3070` "objectui#12968 (objectstack#24324 ruling A)"
  - `ChatDockConversation.tsx:8` "⛔ nothing in the eager console graph may import it statically"
  - `ChatDockConversation.tsx:69` "ADR-0057 as amended for objectui#10926 (maintainer ruling 「绑定当前应用（推荐）」)"
  - `ChatDock.appBinding-10926.test.tsx:5` "amended per the maintainer ruling 「绑定当前应用（推荐）」"
- Deviations from the order: the hook pins live in the shared harness `__tests__/useChatConversation.test.tsx` (the card names it), not a new `.test.ts`; the replay deferral in `useDeferredFirstSend` was added because the browser check showed the first message lost under StrictMode; on a double submit the first message wins and the second is dropped; the browser check stubs the Cloud/EE AI service.

## Verification

Browser check against the real console (Vite dev server) over a real showcase backend for auth and sessions. Only `/api/v1/ai/**` is stubbed with Playwright `context.route`, because the AI service is Cloud/EE: an in-memory conversation store that counts every `POST /conversations`, and an SSE chat reply. Script: `/mnt/project-files/ui-orders/32031-shots/browser-check.mjs`. Steps: sign in, open `/ai` three times, sign out from the user menu and back in, open `/ai` again, send one message, reload.

| | after 3 visits | after sign-in visit | after first send + reload |
|---|---|---|---|
| this branch | creates=0, list "No chats yet" | creates=0 | creates=1, one row with 2 messages, reload stays on `/ai/ask/conv_1` |
| base `e627eaa1` | creates=1 at visit 1, list shows an empty "New conversation" | creates=1 | creates=1 |

Shots in `/mnt/project-files/ui-orders/32031-shots/`: `after-1-after-three-visits.png`, `after-2-after-sign-in-visit.png`, `after-3-after-first-send-and-reload.png`, the `before-*` set, and `after-log.txt` / `before-log.txt`. On the base, the single browser context kept its cache pointer across the sign-out, so the visits resumed that one empty row rather than adding more; the N-row case (no cached pointer on each visit) is the hook pin "N visits mint no row".

Local runs on this head:
- Rebased on `origin/main` `99992ddf`; head `6deb19f8`.
- vitest, the 317 test files that reach the changed modules (app-shell and console callers of `AiChatPage`, `useChatConversation`, `ChatDock`, `StudioAiCopilot`): 317 passed, 2400 tests, exit 0 (run on the pre-rebase head `443497f7`; the rebase changed none of these files). The full app-shell suite was not run (about 40 minutes on this box).
- `pnpm --dir ui/packages/app-shell run type-check` after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` (68 tasks): exit 0.
- `npx eslint` on the touched files: 0 errors; warning count unchanged from main.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 27 commands, each run under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, all exit 0. `--ran`: 27 derived, 27 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Changeset: none. `@object-ui/app-shell` is private, so the PR carries `skip-changeset`.
